summary: This branch resolves a stale merge conflict for PR #42 (Phase 5: reconcile MASTER_INDEX.yaml registries with knowledge_engine), merging master into pr42-conflict-resolution cleanly. The diff adds a new idempotent sync script (ai-os-scripts/sync_master_index_registries.py) that upserts one knowledge_engine row per MASTER_INDEX.yaml registries entry with forward (HASH_DRIFTED) and reverse (orphaned row) drift detection, adds matching upsert-knowledge-fragment/list-knowledge subcommands to superboss-register.py reusing existing helpers (_connect, _write_lock, _ensure_knowledge_engine_table, _new_id), wires an automatic re-sync into task-gateway.py's cmd_close guarded by a real git-diff check so it only fires when MASTER_INDEX.yaml was actually touched, adds a rate-limited Owner-email alert on Supabase 401/403 in knowledge_registry_multisource.py (verified against notification_engine.py's actual send-owner CLI arguments), and updates MASTER_INDEX.yaml/OWNER_DECISIONS_NEEDED.yaml/a new reconciliation contract doc to reflect this. I verified: all changed/added Python files parse as valid syntax, all changed/added YAML files parse cleanly, every helper function and CLI subcommand referenced actually exists with matching arguments, and the new sync script's deployed path (ai-os-scripts/ in the repo maps to the real /opt/veridian/ai-os/scripts/ on the live server, confirmed by diffing the repo copy against the live file byte-for-byte) resolves correctly despite the naming difference. The change is purely additive (new file, new subcommands, new function, new registry doc entries) plus one non-breaking hook addition in an existing close pipeline that fails soft (does not abort the close on sync failure). No changes touch .github/workflows/**, migrations, schema, auth, payments, billing, rls, security paths, or .env files, and there is no heavy-deletion pattern, consistent with the pre-assigned tier1 classification.
